The Steam Sale is going on until 4 July so I've been picking up some cheap, indie games. They've got a ton of great stuff on sale, but I'd like to pass on 3 highly rated games that can be picked up super cheap that I'm really enjoying. They might not be to your taste, obviously, but I'm digging them quite a bit.

[The Vanishing of Ethan Carter ](http://store.steampowered.com/app/258520/)($3.99) This is sort of a walking-sim, but it is a puzzle/mystery/horror game as well. You actually get 2 versions of the game when you buy it--the "bonus" is the entire game remastered in the Unreal 4 engine. The game is absolutely gorgeous, but can be slow and somewhat difficult. It has some Lovecraftian elements. Well worth the $3.99.

[A Story About My Uncle ](http://store.steampowered.com/app/278360/)($2.59) Another beautiful looking game, but this one is a first-person platformer. The whole game is about movement which is kind of difficult to describe, but incredibly fun once you get into it. It also has a really sweet story that frames everything. At less than 3 bucks, this one is a complete no-brainer.

[The Stanley Parable ](http://store.steampowered.com/app/221910/)($2.99) This game is pretty well known. It's weird and trippy and will leve your head spinning. Well worth picking up if you haven't yet.
